name: Issue
about: Report a problem, ask a question or suggest a feature
---

## Before submitting

Please consider the following aspects:

- search existing issues to avoid duplicates
- check vignette and package documentation
- read [Asking for help and reporting issues](https://github.com/florianhartig/DHARMa/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#asking-for-help-and-reporting-issues) in the contributing guide


## Contents of the issue

The most suitable content of the issue depends on whether the issue is about a feature request, problem, error or question in your practical work with DHARMa.
In most cases, it is helpful to follow this structure:

1. Motivation of the study.
2. Your model and DHARMa code as you execute it, as a minimal reproducible example that runs as is in a fresh R session (with simulated or reduced data if your data cannot be shared). See [How to make a great R reproducible example](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example) and the [reprex](https://cran.r-project.org/package=reprex) package. Problem reports without a reproducible example may be closed.
3. DHARMa results / error messages, and the output of `sessionInfo()` (shows the versions of R, DHARMa and the model package)
4. Your question
